articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: 2026 Golden Globes: The Biggest Moments, From ​‘One Battle After Another’ to ​Timothée Chalamet. TELEVISION At the 83rd Golden Globe Awards on Sunday, “One Battle After Another” battled off competitors in major film categories, ​Timothée Chalamet continued his ascent as the movie star of the moment and the “Hamlet” origin story “Hamnet” got a boost in the Oscar race with a win for best drama.

articles.summary: Barchart: Netflix Stock Is Beaten Down - But Short Put Plays Are Attractive. Netflix stock has taken a beating, down 27.9% from a peak in late October 2025. Investors aren't too keen on its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. However, one way to play it is to short out-of-the-money (OTM) put options.
